name: 🔥Floor is Lava Tower
desc:
🔥 Welcome to Floor is Lava Tower!

🌋 The floor is rising lava, keep climbing or burn!
⚡ Dodge fiery traps, tricky obstacles, and troll mechanics!
🏆 Reach the top before the tower gets swallowed whole!
😈 Watch Out for Mischievous Trollers!

👉 Like 👍 the game & join the group for exclusive rewards!
